question:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

Irreverent behavior toward anything held sacred or concerning God.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Blasphemy."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given word:
 
 
• **Blasphemy means disrespectful behavior towards anything considered sacred or religious.(ईश्वर-निंदा)**
